about: Accessibility target identity (Task 6.1). "apps" are fake AT-SPI applications with a bus name and pid; an app's children are its windows, every node has its D-Bus object path as "ref". A desktop is an ordered list of app keys. Node defaults: name "", states [], actions [], children []. "text" gives a node the Text interface, "editable_text" the EditableText one. dump_cases run one dump request; action_cases dump "dump.desktop", switch the desktop to "then", and act on the dumped node whose ref is "act.ref", with the dump's identity fields ("override" replaces request fields). "performed" lists every action the fake desktop saw, in order: an error must leave it empty. id_cases cover the short public ids Python derives from a dump. Shared by the Python helper contract and the Rust provider (Task 6.2). Reviewed by hand; edit it directly, nothing regenerates it.
